Varde is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, utilizing data from the National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Register (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Varde's specific data appears in the municipal breakdown for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment [^src1]. The metrics for Varde include the number of stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients, along with calculated rates and confidence intervals [^src1]. This granular, municipality-level reporting is designed to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking across all 98 Danish municipalities within the healthcare system [^src1].
